# pve_replication (Resource)

Manages a storage replication job in the cluster configuration (`/cluster/replication`). A replication job replicates a guest's volumes to another node; the guest binding travels in the job ID, whose first component is the guest's VMID. Jobs run on PVE's own schedule; this resource manages the configuration only and does not wait for syncs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "pve_replication" "vm100" {
  id       = "100-0"
  target   = "pve2"
  schedule = "*/15"
  rate     = 50.5
  comment  = "Replicate vm100 to pve2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Replication Job ID, composed of a Guest ID and a job number separated by a hyphen, i.e. `<GUEST>-<JOBNUM>` (e.g. `100-0`). The guest ID binds the job to that guest. Changing this value forces recreation.
- `target` (String) Target node that receives the replicated volumes. The pin's update verb carries no target parameter, so changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form description (up to 4096 characters). Removing it from configuration clears the comment upstream.
- `disable` (Boolean) Flag to disable/deactivate the job without deleting it. Leaving the attribute unset keeps the job enabled; removing a previously set `true` re-enables the job upstream.
- `rate` (Number) Rate limit in MB/s (megabytes per second) applied to the replication stream. Must be at least 1. Removing the attribute from configuration clears the limit upstream.
- `schedule` (String) Storage replication schedule as a subset of a `systemd` calendar event (e.g. `*/15`, `Mon..Fri *-*-* 02:00`). PVE defaults to `*/15` when unset.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Configuration digest of the job, usable to detect concurrent upstream modifications.
- `guest` (Number) Guest ID the job replicates, decoded by PVE from the job ID.
- `jobnum` (Number) Job number component of the replication job ID.
- `type` (String) Section type as reported by PVE; always `local`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# Import an existing replication job by its ID:
terraform import pve_replication.vm100 100-0
```
